subject: Quick thought on the Florida Dental Health website and a quick prototype
body: Hi team at Florida Dental Health And Esthetics Institute, I came across your practice while looking at Miramar dental providers and really appreciate your science-based approach to biomimetic dentistry, especially your focus on preserving natural tooth structure and minimizing unnecessary root canals. While exploring http://myfloridadentist.net/, I noticed that your main landing page structure could benefit from a few quick usability tweaks. Specifically, making the primary phone number a prominent, clickable button on mobile and adding dedicated sections for Dr. Isabel Suate, Dr. Ana Toro, and Dr. Emilia Mas would make it much easier for patients to connect with your team right away. Because I love the work you do, I went ahead and built a clean, modern preview of your site here: https://nayom-biz-0x88d9a43e1487d2c1-0xcce12b98cc570f1-2lvn6lz08.vercel.app. Feel free to check out the live preview. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
business_name: Florida Dental Health And Esthetics Institute
key_improvements: Made the primary phone number a clickable button on all viewports for easier mobile booking
Streamlined practitioner bios and profiles directly into the layout
